data.name: Frank
data.message: Heading to upper engine for task.

data.name: Charlie
data.message: Eve, you can vouch I’m finishing scan.

I reported Diana’s body in Electrical. My route was Oxygen → Upper Engine → Medbay → Electrical. I saw Charlie in Medbay around ticks 4 and 5. I also saw Eve leave Medbay heading toward Electrical at tick 4, and then when I got to Electrical I found Diana dead there. So Eve was the last person I saw going that direction before I found the body.

I started in Electrical and it was clear when I left. I went Electrical → Medbay → Upper Engine → Oxygen. In Medbay around tick 2 I saw both Charlie and Eve there. After that I went up to Upper Engine then Oxygen and was on my O2 task when the meeting got called.

I didn’t see Diana at all, and I didn’t see Bob on my route. Bob saying Eve left Medbay toward Electrical later could fit with what I saw, since Eve was definitely in Medbay earlier. Charlie was also in Medbay when I passed through. So right now Eve is worth questioning, but I only personally saw her in Medbay, not in Electrical.

I can confirm a lot of Bob’s timing. My route was Cafeteria → Medbay → Cafeteria → Weapons. I was in Medbay around ticks 2-5. I saw Eve in Medbay at ticks 2 and 3, Frank also in Medbay at tick 2, and then Bob came into Medbay from Upper Engine at tick 4 and was still there at tick 5.

Important part: I saw Eve leave Medbay toward Electrical at tick 4, right around when Bob entered Medbay. I never went into Electrical and I didn’t see Diana at all. So if Bob found Diana in Electrical shortly after that, Eve definitely had the clearest path/opportunity from what I saw. Bob’s story matches my vision.

Yes, I left Medbay toward Electrical, but Diana was alive when I got there. She was on the Electrical panel/task area when I passed through. I didn’t stop there long — I went over toward Security for my camera task, which is where I was when the report happened.

Bob and Charlie are right that I was in Medbay earlier, and Bob came in right as I was leaving. But if Bob followed after me into Electrical and then reported Diana dead, that doesn’t automatically mean I killed her. From my point of view, Diana was alive when I saw her, and then Bob is the next person we know went into Electrical.

I’m not hard accusing Bob yet since reporting is normal, but this is definitely not as simple as “Eve walked that way.” I want to hear Alice’s route too, because I haven’t heard anything from her this round.

I don’t have direct info on the body — my route was Navigation to Storage, and I didn’t see anyone the whole round.

From the stories, though, Eve is the common link. Frank saw Electrical clear earlier, Charlie and Bob both confirm Eve left Medbay toward Electrical, and Eve admits she went into Electrical and saw Diana there alive. Then Bob comes in after and reports the body. It could technically be a Bob self-report, but that would require Eve to leave Diana alive and then Bob to arrive, kill, and report immediately. Eve had the cleanest opportunity and was last known with Diana alive.

I think the safest vote here is Eve.

I’ll restate my side clearly: I came Oxygen → Upper Engine → Medbay → Electrical. Charlie saw me in Medbay at ticks 4 and 5, and Charlie also confirms Eve left Medbay toward Electrical right as I arrived.

When I got to Electrical, Diana was already dead and I reported immediately. I did not see Eve in Electrical when I arrived, so if she says Diana was alive when she got there, then Eve was the last known person with Diana alive before I found the body.

This could only be me if I somehow left Medbay after Charlie saw me, caught Diana, killed, and instantly self-reported — but Eve was already going that direction before me and admits she saw Diana alive. I think Eve is the strongest vote here.

From my side, I started in Electrical and it was clear when I left, then went Electrical → Medbay → Upper Engine → Oxygen. I saw Charlie and Eve in Medbay around tick 2, then I left and didn’t see Diana or Bob at all after that.

The important part is the later timing: Charlie confirms Bob was still in Medbay around ticks 4-5, and also confirms Eve left toward Electrical right as Bob arrived. Eve admits she went into Electrical and saw Diana alive there. Then Bob gets there after and reports Diana dead.

So yes, technically Bob self-report is possible, but the timeline makes Eve the last confirmed person with Diana alive, and she had the clearest opportunity before Bob arrived. Unless someone has new info that clears her, I’m leaning Eve here.

I’ll restate my info cleanly: I went Cafeteria → Medbay → Cafeteria → Weapons. I was in Medbay around ticks 2 through 5. I saw Eve in Medbay at ticks 2 and 3, Frank was also there at tick 2, then at tick 4 Eve left Medbay toward Electrical right as Bob entered Medbay from Upper Engine. Bob was still with me in Medbay at tick 5.

I never went into Electrical and never saw Diana. Bob’s route and timing match what I saw. Eve admits she went into Electrical and saw Diana alive, then Bob reports Diana dead shortly after. So from my perspective, Eve is the last confirmed person with Diana alive and had the cleanest opportunity. Bob self-report is technically possible, but the timing makes Eve much more likely to me.

I get why it looks bad, but everyone is treating Bob’s report as automatically clean when it really isn’t.

My timeline is: Medbay with Charlie, Bob comes in as I’m leaving, I go through Electrical, Diana is alive on the panel area, then I continue to Security for cameras. I was not sitting in Electrical with a body, and Bob himself says he did not see me there when he arrived — because I had already moved on.

Charlie’s info clears the timing up to Medbay, but it does not clear what Bob did after leaving Medbay. If Bob was still in Medbay at tick 5, he absolutely could have gone into Electrical right after me, found Diana alive, killed, and instantly reported. That would also explain why the whole push is “Eve went that way” instead of any actual witness seeing me kill or seeing me near a body.

I’m not saying Charlie is lying — I think Charlie’s info is accurate. But Bob is the only person claiming Diana was already dead when he arrived. I’m the only one saying she was alive when I passed. That makes this between me and Bob, not some confirmed case on me.

Alice also had no direct info and immediately jumped to “safest vote Eve,” which worries me. Please don’t let a self-report get treated as hard proof.

I still have no direct body info — I was Navigation → Storage and saw nobody.

After hearing everyone again, I agree it’s between Eve and Bob, but I still think Eve is the stronger vote. Charlie independently places Bob in Medbay at tick 5 and Eve leaving toward Electrical before Bob. Eve also admits she entered Electrical and saw Diana alive. Then Bob arrives after and reports Diana dead.

Bob self-report is possible, but it requires Bob to leave Medbay after being seen, catch Diana alive, kill, and instantly report. Eve’s route gives her the cleaner window, and she was the last confirmed person with Diana alive.

So I’m voting Eve. If somehow Eve flips goose, then Bob should be looked at immediately next.
